szoveg_eredeti:
The Beijing-based firm’s adjusted net profit for the quarter was 1.9 billion yuan, slightly missing analysts’ expectations of 2.2 billion yuan

Chinese food-delivery giant Meituan reported a second consecutive profitable quarter on Friday, as the company navigates intensifying competition from Alibaba Group Holding and JD.com while seeking to sustain its earnings recovery.

The Beijing-based firm’s adjusted net profit for the three months ended September came in at 1.9 billion yuan (US$285.1 million), slightly missing analysts’ expectations of 2.2 billion yuan, marking a second straight quarterly profit after the company returned to the black in the previous quarter.
